complete_examples.text: With this regard, a multi-time-step method separating the VTS interaction into the VT solution and the substructure solution is an alternative solution.

Most importantly, the multi-time-step method provides an effective approach for the solution of VTS interaction, where the VT system and the sub-structural system are established as two sub-systems independently.
The multi-time-step method is then used to improve the solution efficiency.
More detailed information about the multi-time-step method can be found in Refs. [37, 38].
